scripts.vercel-build: npm install -g pnpm@10.21.0 && pnpm install && pnpm -r build
scripts.phase0: pnpm -r --filter './packages/**' build && pnpm --filter @document-autocapture/demo-react phase0:bench && pnpm --filter @document-autocapture/eval-harness phase0:report
scripts.bakeoff: pnpm -r --filter './packages/**' build && pnpm --filter @document-autocapture/demo-react bakeoff:bench && pnpm --filter @document-autocapture/eval-harness bakeoff:report
scripts.realclip: pnpm --filter @document-autocapture/eval-harness build && pnpm --filter @document-autocapture/eval-harness realclip:ingest && pnpm --filter @document-autocapture/eval-harness realclip:tune
scripts.perf:gates: pnpm no-onnx && pnpm phase0 && pnpm bakeoff && pnpm realclip && pnpm opencv:regression && pnpm --filter @document-autocapture/eval-harness verify:gates
scripts.perf:gates:strict: pnpm no-onnx && pnpm phase0 && pnpm bakeoff && pnpm realclip && pnpm opencv:regression && pnpm --filter @document-autocapture/eval-harness verify:gates:strict
scripts.size:gates: pnpm ml:model:size && pnpm -r --filter './packages/**' build && pnpm --filter @document-autocapture/demo-react build && node scripts/verify-bundle-size.mjs
scripts.brand:check: bash -lc 'if rg -n --hidden --glob "!node_modules/**" --glob "!.git/**" "d[o]cuscan|@d[o]cuscan|D[O]CUSCAN|D[o]cuscan" .; then echo "Brand check failed"; exit 1; fi'
scripts.release:verify: pnpm brand:check && pnpm no-onnx && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm e2e && pnpm perf:gates && pnpm size:gates
scripts.publish:dry-run: pnpm --filter js-document-autocapture publish --dry-run --access public --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter react-document-autocapture publish --dry-run --access public --no-git-checks
scripts.publish:npm: pnpm --filter js-document-autocapture publish --access public --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter react-document-autocapture publish --access public --no-git-checks
